records.title: Two-Headed Monster And Crossed Co-Attention Networks
records.reason: Two-Headed Monster uses two symmetric encoders and a decoder with crossed co-attention to improve machine-translation BLEU; no serving, latency, memory or inference-system optimization is established.

records.title: Path-Adaptive Matting for Efficient Inference Under Various Computational Cost Constraints
records.reason: PAM learns context-dependent paths and connect layers under FLOP constraints for image matting; the independent image task provides no concrete LLM or inference-infrastructure connection.

records.title: Efficient Multi-scale Masked Autoencoders with Hybrid-Attention Mechanism for Breast Lesion Classification
records.reason: MIRAM combines low-resolution semantic and linear-complexity reconstruction decoders to make mammography self-supervised training cheaper; the target is biomedical representation training rather than LLM inference.

records.title: EmoPrefer: Can Large Language Models Understand Human Emotion Preferences?
records.reason: The current official arXiv abstract describes EmoPrefer emotion-preference annotations and an MLLM preference-prediction benchmark, despite the input EMER-Ranker title; lower annotation cost is not LLM execution efficiency.

records.title: Learning Temporal Abstractions via Variational Homomorphisms in Option-Induced Abstract MDPs
records.reason: The paper explicitly targets slow explicit chain-of-thought generation with latent-space reasoning, modeling thoughts as temporally extended options and introducing VMOC plus variational homomorphisms as a foundation for efficient implicit LLM inference.

records.title: InPhyRe Discovers: Large Multimodal Models Struggle in Inductive Physical Reasoning
records.reason: InPhyRe measures inductive physical reasoning on synthetic collision videos with unseen physical laws, diagnosing language bias and visual trustworthiness; this is a capability benchmark rather than an inference-performance benchmark.

records.title: Message Passing on the Edge: Towards Scalable and Expressive GNNs
records.reason: EB-1WL and EB-GNN pass messages along graph edges/triangles with near-linear cost and stronger graph expressivity; the abstract establishes graph-learning benefits without a concrete connection to LLM inference infrastructure.

records.title: Teaming LLMs to Detect and Mitigate Hallucinations
records.reason: Consortium consistency combines responses from diverse LLM teams to detect and mitigate hallucinations; the primary abstract explicitly reports reduced inference costs relative to single-model consistency, making multi-model selection an execution-efficiency mechanism.

records.title: Thinking Forward and Backward: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning
records.reason: Bi-RAR uses forward/backward information-distance rewards and early trajectory alignment; section 5.4 compares response tokens and search calls during Qwen2.5-3B inference, finding fewer retrievals across datasets and shorter responses on most datasets.

records.title: Ostrakon-VL: Towards Domain-Expert MLLM for Food-Service and Retail Stores
records.reason: Ostrakon-VL adapts Qwen3-VL-8B with QUAD data curation and staged training for food-service/retail perception. The examined training, ShopBench evaluation and ablation sections compare task accuracy and parameter scales, without a concrete latency, memory or serving optimization.

records.title: A$^2$-LLM: An End-to-end Conversational Audio Avatar Large Language Model
records.reason: A2-LLM replaces cascaded language/audio/facial-motion modules with a unified conversational model; the abstract explicitly addresses accumulated pipeline latency and reports 500 ms latency and 0.7 RTF, a concrete real-time LLM deployment contribution.
